$comment: Extraction output schema v1 (feature 007-structured-extraction). SINGLE SOURCE for three consumers: roach's OpenRouter response_format, roach's client-side validation, and Prefect's storage-boundary re-validation. Declared three times it would drift silently. NOTE: beats.items.properties.function.enum below is a PLACEHOLDER — it is regenerated at load time from extraction_vocabulary_terms at the recorded vocabulary version (see service/roach/extraction_schema.py::load_schema). Do not hand-maintain it here.

subtitle.description: Full verbatim transcript of every spoken word, in the original spoken language. Also transcribe on-screen text (captions, overlays) that is not spoken, prefixed with [on-screen]. Use null if there is nothing at all to transcribe.

subtitle_absence.description: Required when subtitle is null; must be null when subtitle is present. Use not_applicable_no_audio when the media carries no audio and no on-screen text by nature; attempted_none_found when transcription was attempted and produced nothing.

beats.description: The ordered structural flow of the content. At least one beat always. Content with no discernible structure is ONE beat carrying the residual function, never an empty array.

position.description: 1-based. Contiguous and unique within the extraction, in the order the beats occur.

function.description: PLACEHOLDER ENUM — regenerated from the vocabulary at load time.

description.description: What actually happens in this beat, grounded only in the media.

attributes.description: At most one value per dimension. Expected to be EMPTY until the external attribute vocabulary (S-05) publishes dimensions — an empty array is the correct inert state, not a failure.

confidence.description: An ordered scale, not a continuous score. A self-reported 0.83 would imply a calibration the model does not have.

summary.description: A concise 2-4 sentence summary of what the content is about and its key message.
